name: linkit
description: Publish Codex-built HTML previews and static bundles as temporary Linkit links.

interface.shortDescription: Share Codex-built pages as temporary links.
interface.longDescription: Linkit turns a single HTML page or static site bundle from Codex into a temporary public preview URL. Linkit is currently free. Links expire after 3 days and include a Linkit badge.
defaultPrompt: @Linkit publish this HTML as a temporary preview link.
